verdicts.summary: Sources hold: every spot-checked date is on its page. It fails on keyframe/ledger consistency in Iran, the Caucasus and Libya: the 644-660 corrections keep land the ledger loses (Armenia, Atropatene 646) or gains only later (Fars 648, Rey 651), keep Makran with no gain event, and Cyrenaica/Tripolitania are dated 647 against 642/643 on the Maghreb page. One small fix applied (predecessor land).

fixes.what: Predecessor land was region Arabia, but the hand-over from Medina in 632 is the Hejaz (found event, keyframe 632 and Medina successor land all say Hejaz).
fixes.why: Rashidun page: "The year 12 Hijri dawned on 18 March 633 with the Arabian peninsula united under the caliph in Medina" - Arabia is united only in 633; islamic-state-of-medina /identity/successors/0/land is region Hejaz.
fixes.fix: Changed region Arabia -> Hejaz (text kept). Re-validated: 0 errors, 0 warnings.

fixes.what: Armenian Highlands and Atropatene are lost in 646 to kingdom-of-armenia, Armenia is never regained, yet the 647-660 corrections (Cliopatria 647 and 656 shapes, north to 43.1 N) keep the whole Caucasus; Atropatene's rebels are not the Armenian kingdom.
fixes.why: Persia page: "The main rebellions were in the Persian provinces of Armenia and Azerbaijan in 646" and "The conquest of Iranian Azerbaijan started in 651". byzantine-empire /ledger/20 has Armenia passing from the Rashidun to Byzantium in 657 (c=2), with no Rashidun mirror. The Cliopatria Kingdom of Armenia row ends in 646.
fixes.fix: Either (a) re-type 646 as contest_start (rebellion) with counterpart "Armenian and Azerbaijani rebels", contest_end 651 for Atropatene, and add a 657 loss of Armenia to byzantine-empire (mirror of byzantine /ledger/20); or (b) keep the 646 loss but subtract Armenian Highlands and Atropatene from the 647-650 correction, subtract Armenia from 651-660 and record its regain if any. Do not name kingdom-of-armenia for Atropatene.

fixes.what: The 644-646 and 647-650 corrections keep Fars and Rey inside although the ledger gains Fars only in 648 (/ledger/39) and Rey in 651 (/ledger/43) from the Sasanians; sasanian-empire loses Media (Rey) in 642.
fixes.why: Persia page: "In c. 643, Uthman ibn Abi al-As seized Bishapur, which signed a peace treaty"; "In 648 ... forced the governor of Estakhr ... to surrender"; Rey besieged in 651 and surrendered "after fierce resistance". sasanian-empire /ledger/114 loses Media in 642.
fixes.fix: Make the corrections and the ledger agree: subtract Fars (admin1 Fars) until 648, or keep it and re-type /ledger/39 and /ledger/43 as reconquests after the revolts the page names ("Fars and Sistan in 649") - contest_start at the revolt, contest_end at the reconquest, counterpart the rebels - instead of gains from sasanian-empire.

fixes.what: Makran (about a quarter of Pakistan, about 0.2 M km2) is kept in every correction from 644, but no ledger event gains it.
fixes.why: The K5 note says "Makran and Pakistan (25%) are left in"; the Persia page has "Makran in 650" among the rebellions and "a simultaneous attack launched against Kerman and Makran" in 651, so it was taken before 650 and again in 651.
fixes.fix: Add a gain of Makran (region Makran) with the year the Persia page supports (before the 650 revolt, c=1-2, or 651 c=2) and a contest for the 650 revolt; or subtract Makran from the 644-650 corrections and gain it in 651.

fixes.why: Maghreb page: Barqa taken "Soon after the fall of Alexandria in 642"; Tripoli "after around a month it also fell in around 643". Rashidun page: "In the ensuing battle in 647, the Exarchate was defeated" (Sufetula). byzantine-empire /ledger/13 loses Cyrenaica in 644 (643-644).

verdicts.summary: Dates hold on every page opened (685 Egypt, 690 Cyrenaica, 705 Balkh, 721 Sindh, 728 Bukhara, 743 Transoxiana, 743 Gujarat). It fails on the Second Fitna: the 684-691 keyframe (Levant and Egypt) drops Iran, the Jazira, Arminiya, eastern Arabia, Libya and Kairouan with no loss events (the 683 loss names only Hejaz, Iraq, Egypt, Yemen) and the 692 keyframe restores them with gains only for Iraq, Khorasan and the Hejaz; Cyrenaica is lost in 690 and never regained; Gujarat is lost in 743 without ever being gained.

fixes.what: The 684-691 correction (Levant + Egypt) removes Khuzestan, Jibal, Isfahan, Rey, Sistan, Azerbaijan, Arminiya, the Jazira, Bahrain, Oman and Nejd, but no ledger event loses them: /ledger/13 (683/11) names only Hejaz, Mesopotamia, Egypt and Yemen; zubayrid /ledger/1 gains Fars and Kerman from the Umayyads in 683 with no mirror here; najdat /ledger/0-1 found and gain Nejd, Bahrain and Oman from the Umayyads in 685 with no mirror here. The 692 keyframe (Cliopatria 692) restores all of them with gains only for Iraq (691), Khorasan (691, c=1), Hejaz (692), Armenia (692) and the Najdat lands (693).
fixes.why: Abd Allah ibn al-Zubayr page: "Most of the Islamic provinces offered their allegiance, including Egypt, Kufa, Yemen and the Qaysi tribes of northern Syria"; Second Fitna page: "most provinces recognized Ibn al-Zubayr as caliph"; Mukhtar page: Iraq "and its dependencies including Arminiya, Adharbayjan, Jibal and parts of the Jazira". Area: 674 shape 7.0 M km2 against roughly 1.3 M km2 for Levant + Egypt.
fixes.fix: Widen /ledger/13 to the provinces that recognised Ibn al-Zubayr (add Fars, Kerman, Khuzestan, Jibal/Media, Isfahan, Sistan, Azerbaijan; Arminiya and the eastern Jazira if the author accepts the Mukhtar page), add a 685 loss of Nejd, Bahrain and Oman to najdat-kharijite-emirate, and widen /ledger/20 (691/10 gain from zubayrid) to Iraq with the same dependencies. Coordinate with the Zubayrid dossier (it must hold what this loses).
